blocks.text: A perfect gift of practicality and novelty, this interior dash lights will be a wonderful surprise for your father, brother, friends, and family.Bring your interior back to life—without guesswork. This WLJH combo pairs the two most-needed bases for dashboards and interior lights.High power 4014 and 3030 LED bulbs are recommended for most applications.from the original, orange sleeved, incandescent bulb illumination to other vivid color LED illumination.Ultra Bright Chipset: 300lumen,360 degree lighting angle design, the wide, even beam improves night-time readability without harsh hotspots, and the low power draw is kind to batteries and plastics.No re-wiring required, LED bulbs plug directly into the same socket baseWorks with most vehicle lighting dimmer controls, LEDs will dim between 6 volts and 12 volts.Night time lighting is improved greatly and even more when used at the same time with our gauges.Plug and Play LED bulbs are easy to install, use less current, produce low heat and increase brightness.Various Applications: Automotive Motorcycle Dash Instrument Bulbs,Clock Lights,Dash Indicator Lights,Check Engine Indicator Lights,Check Transmission Indicator Lights,Fasten Seat Belt Indicator Lights,Hi-Beam Indicator Lights,Parking Brake Indicator Lights,Turn Signal Indicator Lights,Ignition Lights,Radio Dial Lights,Ash Tray Lights.Package Includes:20 x T5 LED bulbs20 x T10 LED bulbs20 x T5 sockets20 x T10 sockets

items.label: Plug-and-Play Non-Polarity
items.value: Install in 5 minutes, no wiring, no polarity flipping, quick DIY install protects clips and trims while saving time; Mixed T10 and T5 sizes cover common small sockets—remove, insert, and drive

items.label: Wide Fit, Multi-Position Use
items.value: Swaps straight into dash gauge backlights, warning icons, indicator,clock, ash tray, radio dial, ignition, dash check, engine check, seat belt, indicator, gear shifter, map, dome, license plate, parking, side-marker, trunk, door, vanity mirror, glove box, HAVC,A/C light and more that use T5 or T10 bases lights

items.label: Stock Dimmer Compatible,Night-Friendly
items.value: Driver-tuned 3030 & 4014 SMD LEDs work with the factory dimmer for smooth, even light -no hot spots, no glare

items.label: 300 Lumen Wide Beam
items.value: High-output chips flood the interior and exterior for sharper night-time readings and wider side vision,360-degree spread

items.label: What You Get and Support
items.value: 20× T10 Led + 20× T5 Led with twist sockets ( totally 80 pieces ) deliver full coverage for most position—perfect for full refresh, color matching, or spares; 50,000hrs Long Lifetime, backed by WLJH two-year support
